info.title: Blaaiz Platform API - List Crypto Wallet Addresses
info.description: Get deposit addresses for one business crypto wallet.

scopes.crypto-wallet:read: Read crypto wallets and deposit addresses.

get.description: Get deposit addresses for one business crypto wallet. To get the addresses for one customer, use the optional `customer_id` query parameter. Required scope: `crypto-wallet:read`.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Optional. Return only the addresses for this customer.

404.description: The wallet does not belong to your business or does not exist.
